dialogues.jp: さっきから、街の｛にぎ／賑｝やかな｛ざっとう／雑踏｝が聞こえている。
dialogues.en:
I could hear the noise and bustle of a traffic jam just
outside the house.
dialogues.text:
I could hear the noise and bustle of a traffic jam just
outside the house.

dialogues.jp: ｛しゃこう／遮光｝カーテン越しに、太陽の｛ほの／仄｝かな光を感じる。
dialogues.en:
The sun was peeking through the window, through the shade of
the curtains.
dialogues.text:
The sun was peeking through the window, through the shade of
the curtains.

dialogues.jp:
そろそろ、寝ているのもかったるくなってきた。
それに、寝ていると言っても、なんとなくベッ
ドに横になっているだけだ。
dialogues.en:
I don't think I can stay asleep any longer. Besides, for
some reason I ended up sleeping across the bed.
dialogues.text:
I don't think I can stay asleep any longer. Besides, for
some reason I ended up sleeping across the bed.

dialogues.jp:
ゆっくりと目を開けると、薄明るい部屋の風景
が目に映る。
dialogues.en: I finally open my eyes to the dusky room.
dialogues.text: I finally open my eyes to the dusky room.

dialogues.jp: 時計を見ると、もう昼を過ぎていた。
dialogues.en: I check the clock. It's already past noon.
dialogues.text: I check the clock. It's already past noon.

dialogues.jp: せめて午後からは出掛けるか。
dialogues.en: Now that it's afternon, I might as well go out.
dialogues.text: Now that it's afternon, I might as well go out.

dialogues.jp:
俺は起き上がってグッと背伸びをすると、顔を
洗いに洗面所に向かった……。
dialogues.en:
I rose from my bed and stretched, then went to wash my
face...
dialogues.text:
I rose from my bed and stretched, then went to wash my
face...

dialogues.jp:
ぐっすりばっちり眠って、起きてみればすでに
昼を過ぎていた。
dialogues.en: My sleep was so long and deep that it stretched past noon.
dialogues.text: My sleep was so long and deep that it stretched past noon.

dialogues.jp:
ま、せっかくだし午後はどこかへ出かけること
にした。
dialogues.en: Well, afternoon's not a bad time to go out anyway.
dialogues.text: Well, afternoon's not a bad time to go out anyway.
